title: Street setbacks Element Objectives
text: Development is to achieve the following Element Objectives: O 2.3.1 The setback of the development from the street reinforces and/or complements the existing or proposed landscape character of the street. O 2.3.2 The street setback provides a clear transition between the public and private realm. O 2.3.3 The street setback assists in achieving visual privacy to apartments from the street. O 2.3.4 The setback of the development enables passive surveillance and outlook to the street.
notes: The Volume 2 intent paragraph on local variation is removed (now Chapter 1) (C4P2-070).
